////							 			HARDWARE		 								////
// Parameters:                                                                                //
//                                                                         					  //
// [ID]int 					= The ID of the object.                                   		  //
// [TYP]int					= The type of the hardware.                                       //
// 							  	0 = CPU                                                       //
//							  	1 = GPU                                                       //
//							  	2 = RAM                                                       //
//							  	3 = Storage                                                   //
//							  	4 = Sound Chip                                                //
//							  	5 = Vents                                                     //
//							  	6 = ROM                                                       //
//							  	7 = Controller                                                //
//							  	8 = Case                                                      //
// [NAME (LANG)]string 		= The name of the hardware in the respective language.     		  //
// [DATE](MONTH) (YEAR) 	= The date when the hardware is available.     			  		  //
// [RES POINTS]int			= Required research points.										  //
// [PRICE]int				= How much the hardware costs.                 			  		  //
// [DEV COSTS]int			= The development costs of the hardware.       			  		  //
// [TECHLEVEL]int			= The tech level of the hardware.                                 //
// [ONLY_STATIONARY]		= For stationary consoles only.                                   //
// [ONLY_HANDHELD]			= For handheld consoles only.                                     //
//                                                                                    		  //
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
